description: Save a supported public post URL to the connected Skwirl account when the user asks to keep it. Skwirl queues the link and fetches the public post for asynchronous processing. New notes appear after successful processing. An existing normalized link in this account returns 'Already saved.' without replacing its reminder. Unsupported links, permission or account restrictions, and queue limits return explanatory failure text. Use search_stash or recent_stash to find a processed note later. Usage examples: save_link({"url":"https://www.instagram.com/reel/ABC123/","note":"Try this recipe"}). Returns text.

note.description: Optional free-text string, up to 500 characters, explaining why the user wants to save this link; omit if not supplied. Example: Try this recipe.

url.description: HTTPS URL for a supported public post, such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or X. Example: https://www.instagram.com/reel/ABC123/.

name: save_link
title: Save a public post link
